StartupChecklist.title: Startup Checklist
StartupChecklist.planning.1.details: Our idea is a tech platform called "Mahila Suraksha" that integrates data, resources, and community in the fight against sexual violence.
StartupChecklist.planning.2.details: Analyzing women's safety-related apps, NGOs, and government initiatives in India and globally.
StartupChecklist.planning.3.details: Identifying the features and shortcomings of other safety apps (e.g., Safetipin, Circle of 6).
StartupChecklist.planning.4.details: A hybrid model: generating revenue through grants, corporate CSR funds, and premium features (if possible).
StartupChecklist.planning.5.details: Creating a detailed document that includes the mission, vision, operations, marketing, and financial plan.
StartupChecklist.planning.6.details: Mainly women in urban and semi-urban areas, students, NGOs, and government agencies.
StartupChecklist.planning.7.details: "Mahila Suraksha" - this name clearly reflects our mission.
StartupChecklist.planning.8.details: Assessing our strengths (data-driven approach), weaknesses (initial funding), opportunities (growing awareness), and threats (competition).
StartupChecklist.planning.9.details: Estimating operating costs, revenue, and profitability for the first three years.
StartupChecklist.planning.10.details: Estimating initial expenses on app development, hosting, team salaries, and marketing.
